newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Insects stress crops.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Insects stress crops.

text.p: Insects and prolonged dry conditions were causing stress to the dark northern spring wheat crop in North Dakota, grain dealers said Wednesday.
North Dakota dealers said grasshoppers looked set to threaten the state's crops this summer.

"Grasshoppers are starting to be a problem and it's going to continue to get worse. Some guys have already started spraying for them," an eastern North Dakota dealer said. "I know of at least one producer who has had to replant some fields of sugarbeets because they've been eaten up by grasshoppers."
Dealers said grain movement was slow for the most part Wednesday, although one dealer in central Montana said rains in central and western Montana helped spur some farmer selling.
